summary: First-finish smoke test on Turkish real-estate valuation AI app. Backend endpoints all pass (chat create, LLM report message with fields+sections+credit deduction, upload, PDF/DOCX download, mock email, mock credits purchase, FAQ chat, list, delete). Frontend loads dashboard with authenticated seed user, template selection opens chat panel with all key UI controls (chat-input, send-btn, upload-btn, download-pdf-btn, download-docx-btn, email-report-btn, credits-btn). LLM message not re-triggered from UI to conserve budget (already validated end-to-end via backend).
passed: POST /api/chats (report/konut) returns 200 with chat_id and Turkish greeting assistant message

POST /api/chats/{id}/message with rich Turkish input: assistant reply generated by Claude Sonnet, chat.fields populated (12 fields), chat.sections populated (6 sections), credits deducted 500->480 (10 for chat create + 10 for message)
GET /api/chats/{id}/download/pdf: 200, Content-Type application/pdf, starts with %PDF-1.4, 5486 bytes
POST /api/credits/purchase {package_id:'starter'}: added 500 credits, mock:true, new balance 980
GET /api/chats: returns wrapped list {chats:[...]} with 5 items
DELETE /api/chats/{id}: returns success and subsequent GET returns 404
Frontend dashboard renders with session_token cookie; sidebar shows 'Test Valuer', credits 980
new-chat-btn -> template-card-konut -> chat-panel with greeting; preview panel shows report title with report_no
All required data-testids present: chat-input, send-btn, upload-btn, download-pdf-btn, download-docx-btn, email-report-btn, credits-btn
notes: Per E1 guidance, only 1 real LLM message was sent (via backend) to conserve budget; UI LLM round-trip was skipped after confirming all UI controls render. Mock endpoints validated: email + credits purchase both return mock:true as expected.
